_note: Example cards only. Chance = bonuses only (good news). Special = everything else, including all the penalties (move back, skip a turn…). The team will send the real Chance and Special cards later. 'effect' lets the app move the goose automatically; type 'manual' = players apply it themselves.

chance.title: Tailwind!
chance.text: A gust of wind lifts your feathers. Move forward 2 spaces.

chance.title: Bonus round
chance.text: Answer a Hard question from any category. Right: +4 spaces. Wrong: stay where you are.

chance.title: Lucky egg
chance.text: Keep this card. Use it once to cancel a move back.

special.title: Swap!
special.text: Swap places with the player of your choice.

special.title: Goose nap
special.text: You fell asleep on the job. Skip your next turn.

special.title: Honk attack
special.text: Every other player moves back 1 space.

special.title: Teach me
special.text: Explain a web word in English to the group in 20 seconds. Success: +2 spaces.

special.title: Wi-Fi down
special.text: Your connection dropped. Move back 1 space.
